test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In an election between two candidates, 2% of the voters did not cast their votes. Out of the polled votes, 5% were declared invalid. One candidate secured 65% of the valid votes. If the total number of voters was 25,20,000, how many valid votes did the losing candidate receive?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total voters = 2520000

Votes cast = 98% ⇒ 2520000 × 0.98 = 2469600

Valid votes = 95% ⇒ 2469600 × 0.95 = 2346120

Losing candidate = 35% of valid votes

**∴ Votes = 2346120 × 0.35 = 821142**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total voters = 2520000

2% did not vote, 5% invalid votes, winner got 65%

**Formula used:**

Valid votes = Total × (votes cast%) × (valid%)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Votes cast = 2520000 × 98/100 = 2469600

⇒ Valid votes = 2469600 × 95/100 = 2346120

⇒ Losing candidate gets 35%

⇒ Votes = 2346120 × 35/100 = 821142

**∴ The correct answer is 821142.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage

Apply percentages step by step: Total × 0.98 × 0.95

Complement Rule

If one gets 65%, other gets 35%

Election Problems

Always remove non-voters and invalid votes first
